title: The category of formations of finite groups and topology
summary: This paper explores the interplay between category theory, topology, and the algebraic theory of finite groups. Our analysis unfolds in three stages. First, we establish the foundational universe of our objects: the complete and cocomplete posetal category of group classes, $\mathrm{CG}$. Second, we formalize the collection of closure operators themselves as a category, \textbf{CL}, proving it is a complete lattice.
